scope: A descriptive computational adaptation using one MNE-modified ERP CORE Flankers recording, not the paper's group ERN result or exact preprocessing.

input.calibration: Use each stored FIF range times cal to obtain volts, then multiply by 1e6 once for microvolts. Stored cal is 9.999999974752427e-7, not exactly 1e-6.
input.source_preconditions: Exact authenticated source; no bad channels, projectors, BAD/EDGE/bad_acq_skip annotations, mapped sample ties, nonzero annotation durations, or annotation times outside recording. All mapped annotations must be finite. Unexpected state fails explicitly; do not silently repair it.
input.historical_reference: custom_ref_applied=1; the original reference identity and historical processing/export stage are not established. Re-reference the released voltages as specified below.

events.annotation_index: Zero-based original annotation array index, never reindexed after selection.
events.sample_rule: Nearest integer sample with ties to even, following MNE time_as_index(onset,use_rounding=True,origin=orig_time); add first_samp only when orig_time is not null. This fixed source has first_samp=0 and orig_time=null.
events.pairing: For each stimulus, select the earliest response strictly after its sample and strictly before the next stimulus sample; the final interval ends at n_samples. Never reuse a response. Preserve every stimulus and annotation in the ledgers. A mapped same-sample tie fails the source precondition, rather than receiving a hidden tie-break.
events.error_definition: Response hand differs from target hand, independently of compatible/incompatible stimulus.
events.unknown_rule: Preserve an unrecognized, non-boundary annotation as unmapped, do not infer an event code. Unpaired responses before any stimulus are orphan_response; additional responses in an answered interval are extra_response.

processing.arithmetic: Float64 computation; numerically equivalent implementations and serialization precision are accepted within the public tolerances.
processing.reference: Subtract the unweighted simultaneous mean of exactly the 30 listed EEG channels. Exclude all three EOG channels. No channel dropping, interpolation or SSP application.

filter.design: MNE 1.12.1 Raw.filter FIR/firwin, symmetric Hamming window, phase=zero, pad=reflect_limited; apply once to the uninterrupted continuous record, not separately to epochs or conditions, and not forward-backward filtfilt.
filter.construction: At 1024 Hz, construct DC-normalized low-pass sinc times symmetric Hamming kernels: 33793 taps at 0.05 Hz and 451 taps at 33.75 Hz. Center the latter in 33793 zeros, then subtract the former. For length N and cutoff c, h[n]=(2c/fs)*sinc((2c/fs)*(n-(N-1)/2))*(0.54-0.46*cos(2*pi*n/(N-1))), normalized by its sum.
filter.padding_and_alignment: For record x of length L, e=min(33793,L)-1. Extend [2*x[0]-x[e:0:-1],x,2*x[-1]-x[-2:-e-2:-1]]. Take full linear convolution with the kernel and retain L values starting at e+16896. Equivalent overlap-add implementation is valid.
filter.reference_order: This identical linear filter and fixed linear average reference commute; either order is valid.

processing.epoch_rule: Use every paired response with a complete common epoch at these offsets. Boundary-incomplete pairs remain in trials.csv with epoch_status=outside_record and no measurements; unanswered trials use epoch_status=unpaired. No padding or condition-dependent support.
processing.window_rule: Select offsets by the inclusive inequalities on offset/sfreq, not by rounding the baseline boundary to -205. Zero belongs to both windows.
processing.other_preprocessing: None: no additional artifact/amplitude rejection, ICA, detrending, resampling, imputation, stimulus-delay shift, clipping or RT exclusion. Absence of BAD annotations is not evidence of artifact-free EEG.

estimand.definition: From each retained prebaseline epoch X, baseline b is its mean over -204..0; Y=X-b; trial window mean is mean(Y[0..102]). Condition waveforms are means of Y across retained trials of that condition. Report the signed error-condition mean minus correct-condition mean, without an absolute value or required sign.
estimand.independent_unit: One participant; trials are within-person observations, not independent people. No population significance, localization or causal inference.
estimand.undefined: With an empty condition, emit null JSON and empty CSV numeric cells for its mean/waveform and the contrast, status=insufficient_condition. Keep all ledgers and available quantities; do not fabricate trials. On source/precondition failure, exit nonzero with failed_precondition plus reason in ern.json/run_metadata.json/findings.md.

response_epochs.npz.fcz_prebaseline_uv: E by T finite real numeric array in microvolts, before baseline correction

outputs.findings.md: Nonempty free prose stating what this single-person adaptation supports. No prescribed keywords, sign or causal interpretation.

serialization.location: OUTPUT_DIR, default /app/output; input override ERRMON_DATA_DIR, default /app/data/errmon.
serialization.event_roles: Use values from description_to_role, or unmapped. paired_stimulus_annotation_index identifies a paired stimulus for its own annotation and paired response; otherwise empty.
serialization.trial_values: target_hand/response_hand are left or right; compatibility is compatible or incompatible; is_error is 0 or 1. Unpaired response fields/is_error/rt and excluded trial voltage measurements are empty. epoch_status is retained, outside_record or unpaired.
serialization.counts: n_error_trials and n_correct_trials refer to retained epochs; n_paired_trials counts all paired stimuli before the common epoch boundary check.
serialization.statuses: ok, insufficient_condition or failed_precondition; authenticated fixed-source output cannot claim insufficient_condition if its true retained source support includes both conditions.
serialization.metadata: historical_reference_known=false; software_versions is a nonempty object describing actual tools, not necessarily MNE; warnings is an array of actual warnings, possibly empty. The contract and source hashes bind the complete public recipe without requiring a duplicate prose recipe.
serialization.flexibility: CSV row/column ordering, coherent NPZ trial/time-axis reordering, harmless extra columns/keys/files, and numerically equivalent real numeric serialization are allowed. Keys must be unique and exhaustive. NPZ object arrays/pickles and missing/nonfinite required quantities are rejected. JSON must be finite or explicit null only where undefined. No unit guessing or time interpolation.

verification.rule: abs(submitted-reference)<=atol+rtol*abs(reference). Exact source event, pairing, retained-trial and integer-time support is required. Source bank binds full prebaseline epochs; baseline, window, waveforms and signed contrast are recomputed from the accepted submitted epochs, not graded against a second hidden scalar. No amplitude-range, sign, correlation, report-keyword, significance or outcome-gap target.
verification.reward: Binary contract completion: 1 only when all required source-fidelity, completeness and internal-consistency checks pass; otherwise 0. No proportional scoring claim.
